assassinate.en: The history lesson explained that rulers often feared plots to assassinate them.
assassinate.zh: 歷史課說明統治者往往擔心有人策劃暗殺他們。

bleed.en: Even a small paper cut can bleed for a short time.
bleed.zh: 即使小小的紙割傷也可能短暫流血。

blond.en: The actor wore a blond wig for the school play.
blond.zh: 那位演員在校園戲劇中戴了一頂金髮假髮。

blonde.en: The portrait shows a woman wearing a blonde wig.
blonde.zh: 那幅肖像畫中是一位戴著金髮假髮的女性。

bloody.en: The novel describes a bloody conflict without focusing on graphic details.
bloody.zh: 這本小說描寫一場血腥衝突，但沒有著重血腥細節。

bomb.en: The museum exhibit explains how a bomb shaped wartime history.
bomb.zh: 博物館展覽說明炸彈如何影響戰爭史。

bullet.en: The museum displayed an old bullet beside other historical artifacts.
bullet.zh: 博物館把一枚舊子彈與其他歷史文物一起展示。

corpse.en: The detective novel mentions a corpse without describing it in detail.
corpse.zh: 這本偵探小說提到一具遺體，但沒有詳細描寫。

hijack.en: The documentary explains why authorities work to prevent attempts to hijack aircraft.
hijack.zh: 紀錄片說明當局為何努力防止劫持飛機的企圖。

kidnap.en: The news report discussed laws designed to prevent attempts to kidnap children.
kidnap.zh: 新聞報導討論為防止綁架兒童而制定的法律。

lethal.en: The warning label states that some chemicals can be lethal if mishandled.
lethal.zh: 警告標籤指出某些化學品若處理不當可能致命。

missile.en: The history textbook includes a photograph of an early missile.
missile.zh: 歷史課本收錄了一張早期飛彈的照片。

murder.en: The documentary examines how courts investigate a murder case.
murder.zh: 這部紀錄片探討法院如何調查謀殺案件。

murderer.en: The novel reveals the murderer only in its final chapter.
murderer.zh: 這本小說直到最後一章才揭露兇手。

poison.en: The science lesson warned that poison should never be handled carelessly.
poison.zh: 自然課提醒有毒物質絕不能隨意處理。

poisonous.en: The sign warns visitors that some wild plants are poisonous.
poisonous.zh: 告示提醒遊客某些野生植物有毒。

punch.en: The coach stopped the drill when one player tried to punch another.
punch.zh: 當一名球員試圖揮拳打另一人時，教練立刻停止練習。

razor.en: The museum displayed an old razor as part of a household exhibit.
razor.zh: 博物館把一把舊刮鬍刀放在居家用品展區展示。

rifle.en: The museum kept the antique rifle locked inside a glass case.
rifle.zh: 博物館把那把古董步槍鎖在玻璃展示櫃裡。

shoot.en: The film avoids showing characters shoot anyone on screen.
shoot.zh: 這部電影避免在畫面中呈現角色開槍傷人的情節。

shot.en: The news report confirmed that a shot was heard nearby.
shot.zh: 新聞報導證實附近曾傳出一聲槍響。

shove.en: School rules clearly state that students must never shove others.
shove.zh: 校規明確規定學生不得推擠他人。

siege.en: The history class studied how a long siege affected the city.
siege.zh: 歷史課研究一場長期圍城如何影響那座城市。

skull.en: The science museum displayed a model skull for anatomy study.
skull.zh: 科學博物館展示一個頭骨模型供解剖學習。

slam.en: The teacher asked everyone not to slam the classroom door.
slam.zh: 老師請大家不要用力甩上教室門。

slap.en: The school policy says students must never slap another person.
slap.zh: 校規規定學生不得掌摑他人。

slash.en: The editor removed a scene in which a character tried to slash a painting.
slash.zh: 編輯刪除了角色企圖劃破畫作的場景。

slaughter.en: The history text discusses slaughter as a tragic consequence of war.
slaughter.zh: 歷史課文把屠殺視為戰爭的悲劇性後果來討論。

slay.en: In the old legend, the hero is said to slay a mythical beast.
slay.zh: 在古老傳說中，英雄據說擊敗了一頭神話怪獸。

smuggle.en: Customs officers work to stop attempts to smuggle illegal goods across borders.
smuggle.zh: 海關人員努力阻止走私非法物品越境的行為。

snatch.en: The safety poster warns people not to snatch belongings from others.
snatch.zh: 安全海報提醒人們不得搶奪他人物品。

spear.en: The museum displayed a ceremonial spear from an ancient culture.
spear.zh: 博物館展示了一支來自古代文化的儀式用長矛。

stab.en: The play suggests a character may stab another, but shows no graphic scene.
stab.zh: 這齣戲暗示角色可能刺傷另一人，但沒有呈現血腥畫面。

strangle.en: The crime drama mentions an attempt to strangle someone without showing details.
strangle.zh: 這部犯罪劇提到企圖勒住他人的情節，但沒有呈現細節。

suffocate.en: The safety lesson explains that smoke can cause people to suffocate.
suffocate.zh: 安全課程說明濃煙可能使人窒息。

sword.en: The museum displayed an ancient sword behind protective glass.
sword.zh: 博物館把一把古代長劍放在防護玻璃後展示。

terrorism.en: The civics class discussed how societies respond to terrorism through law and cooperation.
terrorism.zh: 公民課討論社會如何透過法律與合作因應恐怖主義。

terrorist.en: The article explains that a terrorist is prosecuted under criminal law.
terrorist.zh: 這篇文章說明恐怖分子會依刑事法律受到起訴。

torture.en: International law prohibits torture and protects basic human rights.
torture.zh: 國際法禁止酷刑並保障基本人權。

weapon.en: The museum labels each historical weapon with its period and origin.
weapon.zh: 博物館為每件歷史武器標示年代與來源。
